result_summary.title: Federation metadata mismatch and expired password reset links in SSO ANZ
result_summary.description: We are encountering two related issues with the SSO Integration Module in the ANZ production environment. First, we are seeing a 'federation metadata mismatch' error during authentication attempts. Second, when users attempt to use the password reset flow, the links provided in the email are expired immediately upon receipt. This is affecting 83 users and preventing them from accessing their accounts or resetting credentials. We need assistance in resolving the metadata configuration and the link expiration timeout.
